resources.string: Consent and permissions required before any capture starts.
Consent granted. Capture is not implemented yet (Phase 1 shell).

FrustraDAR processes camera, microphone and motion signals entirely on your device. Raw camera, audio or motion data never leaves the device; only derived frustration scores and session metadata are sent to the FrustraDAR backend. Foreground-game detection uses your device\'s usage-access permission. You can withdraw consent at any time.
